newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Hansabank up on buoyant Tallinn bourse.
newsitem.headline: Hansabank up on buoyant Tallinn bourse.

text.p: Hansabank rose on Estonia's buoyant bourse on Thursday.
Overall market volume was a healthy 17.8 million kroons and the index climbed 1.87 points to 109.83.
Hansabank, which published monthly figures on Wednesday for October, led the way with trade totalling 8.2 million kroons.
Its shares rose to 108.70 kroons from 106.25 kroons.

Estonian drug producer Tallinn pharmaceutical made its debut on the official list with trade worth 3.6 million kroons and closed at 54.26 kroons versus 54.29 kroons on Wednesday on the secondary list.
Volume on the secondary list was 9.3 million kroons.
